name: Dimitrios Papakonstantinou
bio:
Dimitrios's path to motorsport strategy was unconventional, beginning with a degree in theoretical physics at the University of Athens. He transitioned into motorsport after volunteering at a local rally team, quickly proving his analytical skills were invaluable in race preparation and tactical decision-making. His understanding of complex systems and data analysis gave him an edge in predicting track conditions and competitor strategies.

He honed his craft working his way up through smaller racing teams, developing a reputation for meticulous planning and risk assessment. Dimitrios is known for his pragmatic approach, prioritizing data-driven decisions over intuition. His skill lies in creating robust strategies that minimize potential pitfalls and maximize opportunities for success, even under pressure. He's renowned for his ability to quickly adapt to unforeseen circumstances, often turning potential disasters into strategic advantages.

Now a free agent, Dimitrios seeks a team ready to embrace a data-driven approach to strategy and benefit from his years of experience.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitrios is a man of medium height, with a sturdy build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out slide ruler for 'quick' calculations.
Insists on drinking only Greek mountain tea during races.
Mumbles complex equations under his breath when stressed.
